openActions.title: Cap the code review queue and agree first-response norms
openActions.description: The team reported reviews backing up when too many pull requests wait at once (FB-0003). A shared WIP limit per reviewer and a first-response target should keep the queue moving without blaming individuals.

openActions.title: Expand regression and integration coverage in the delivery pipeline
openActions.description: Recurring feedback pointed to gaps in regression and integration testing before release (FB-0004, FB-0005). The team can prioritize high-risk flows, add automated checks where practical, and define what must pass before merge or deploy.

openActions.title: Add a pre-deploy deployment configuration validation step
openActions.description: The team flagged environment or deployment configuration issues surfacing late (FB-0006). A short checklist or automated diff against known-good settings before promote should catch misconfigurations earlier.

openActions.title: Standardize refinement handoffs and keep QA involved early
openActions.description: The team valued QA participation during refinement (FB-0001) while handoffs between roles still felt unclear (FB-0002). Agree on ready-for-dev criteria, who owns the handoff, and a lightweight refinement template so expectations stay visible.
openActions.teams: Product Team, QA Team, Dev Team

reportExcerpt.themesSummary: Early quality involvement in planning: The team noted that QA participation in refinement helped surface missing acceptance criteria before implementation work progressed. Cross-team delivery handoffs: A recurring positive theme is smoother coordination between backend and frontend during the sprint. Code review throughput: The team reported that the code review queue expanded again during the middle of the sprint. Integration testing and regression risk: Process feedback links a shipped regression to gaps in integration coverage, and the team explicitly called for broader integration tests around payment flows. Deployment pipeline safeguards: The team suggested strengthening the deployment path by automating configuration validation.
